summary.text: Kwabena 'Cubby' Nkromo is the Green Party candidate on the November ballot for Michigan's 10th District. Ballotpedia lists him as a business consultant; in his Ballotpedia survey he describes himself as a civic leader, food-policy advocate and Green Party organizer.

paragraphs.text: Nkromo graduated from South Boston High School and attended Tuskegee University and Clemson University.
His listed career experience includes working as a business consultant.

In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he describes himself as a grassroots civic leader, food-policy advocate and Green Party organizer with more than three decades of experience in community organizing, food systems, public policy, small business and ministry.
The Green Party nominated him at its convention on July 18, 2026.
